answer: With a Weekly community check-in streak over ninety days verified by attendance records, trust accrues only through repeated presence: every week the applicant signs in, the attendance records go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a fake identity that lapses even once loses its standing and must start over. The design treats each week as a cedar: small alone, decisive in sequence. From the nadir to the jade, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
